create_StatsQueue_for_pipeline: create a StatsQueue instance to measure put and get latency between pipeline stages
build_ThreadBasedAsyncQueue_for_low_late: build a _ThreadBasedAsyncQueue to reduce cross-thread handoff latency for foreground consumer threads
review_QueuePerfStats_dataclass: review the QueuePerfStats dataclass fields to understand queue occupancy rate and QPS metrics
set_default_queue_class: set the default queue class to StatsQueue or _ThreadBasedAsyncQueue for all pipeline stages
use_queue_stage_hook: use the _queue_stage_hook async context manager to handle init and EOF signaling for a queue
